description: The Climate Data Store is a catalogue of climate observations, reanalyses and projections. It provides dataset discovery, an API and related computing and training resources for working with climate information. The resource is documented by Copernicus Climate Change Service at ECMWF. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The provider supplies a public web description. Licence and any software or data charges are unconfirmed and require provider clarification. Collection-specific licences, access requirements and coverage must be checked. A portal-level record does not make every product interchangeable. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. It is related to data-cmip6-climate-projections-cds in this catalogue.
